## Summary

<!-- 1-3 bullets describing what changed and why -->

## Linked Issue

Closes #<!-- issue number -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat — new functionality
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] test — tests added/changed
- [ ] chore — maintenance, deps
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] perf — performance

## Test Plan

<!-- How was this tested? What should the reviewer verify? -->

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual verification in dev/staging
- [ ] No regressions in existing flows

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `<type>/<issue>-<description>`
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<type>: <description> (#<issue>)`
- [ ] Pre-commit hook passed (fmt + lint)
- [ ] No secrets committed; Doppler used for new secrets
- [ ] Claude review feedback will be addressed before merge
